name: uniq
summary: Removes or counts consecutive repeated lines.
description: Merges identical lines that follow each other. Watch out: uniq only compares a line with the previous one. To remove duplicates from a whole file, sort it first (sort | uniq, or simply sort -u).

options.description: Prefixes each line with its number of occurrences.
Shows only lines that appear once.
Skips the first N fields when comparing.
Skips the first N characters when comparing.
